spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ऊ,) गृहू (गर्हते) also r. 10th cl. (गृहयते)
To take, to seize, to receive or accept; also ग्रह.

n. (-हं)
1 A house, a mansion, a habitation in general.
2 A wife: (in these senses the plural is always masculine, गृहाः).
3 A name, an appellation.
E.
गृह to receive or take, (grain, goods, &c.) affix क.

m. (-पः)
A small flat oblong stone, used for grinding condiments, &c.
E.
गृह a house, and कच्छप a tortoise.

f. (-न्या)
The aloe, (Aloes perfoliata); also घृतकुमारी, कुमारी, &c.
E.
गृह a house, and कन्या a virgin.

m. (-कः)
A pigeon, a tame or domestic pigeon.
E.
गृह a house, and कपोतक a dove or pigeon.

n. (-णं)
1 Household affairs.
2 House building.
E.
गृह, and करण making.

m. (-कः)
1 A house builder.
2 A thatcher.
E.
गृह, and कारक who makes.

m. (-री)
1 A kind of wasp.
2 A house builder.
E.
गृह a house, and कारिन् who makes, building a nest or house of clay, &c.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Household affairs.
E.
गृह, and कार्य्य business; also गृहकर्म्म, &c.

f. (-धा)
A small house lizard.
E.
गृह a house, and गोधा or गोधिका an iguana; hence also गृहगोधिका, or ध being changed to ल, गृहगोलिका.

f. (-का)
A lizard: see the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A house sparrow.
E.
गृह, and चटक a sparrow.

n. (-द्रं)
1 Private or family afflictions or troubles.
2 A breach in a house.
E.
गृह, and छिद्र a hole; also गृहरग्ध्रं.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born in the house.
m. (-जः)
A slave born in the house.
E.
गृह, and ज born; also गृहजात.

f. (-णी)
Rice water.

f. (-टी)
A terrace in front of a house, a threshold.
E.
गृह a house, and तट a bank.

mf. (-सः-सी)
A domestic slave.
E.
गृह, and दास a slave.

f. (-प्तिः)
A virtuous woman.
E.
गृह, and दीप्ति light.

m. (-रः)
The door of a house.
E.
गृह, and द्वार a door.

m. (-मः)
A plant commonly Medhasriṅgi: see मेढशृङ्गी.
E.
गृह a house, द्रुम a tree, growing near dwellings.

m. (-नः)
A pigeon.
E.
गृह, and नाशन who injures; defacing the walls of a house by building in and about it.

m. (डः)
A sparrow.
E.
गृह, and नीड a nest, who builds his nest in human dwellings.

m. (-तिः)
1 A householder, a man of the second class, or who after having finished his studies is married and settled.
2 A householder of particular merit, giving alms, and performing all the prescribed ceremonies, &c.
3 Maintenance of a sacred and perpetual fire.
4 Virtue, especially of a householder, as hospitality, &c.
E.
गृह a house, and पति lord or master.

m. (-कः)
The site of a habitation, the ground on which it stands, and which is attached to it.
E.
गृह, and पोत a young animal, affix कन्, the rudiments of the house.

m. (-लिः)
Offering of the reliques of a meal, or sacrifice to the spirits of the air, &c.
E.
गृह, and वलि offering.

m. (-यः)
A kind of crane, the Vaca.
E.
गृह a house, बलि food offered in oblation, and प्रिय fond of: see the next.

m. (-भुक्)
1 A sparrow.
2 A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.)
3 A crow.
E.
गृह a house or a wife, बलि grain, &c. used in oblations, or any edible grain, and भुज् who eats; that is, who eats the food of his female, or the fragments of offerings fallen in or about the house; also गृहवलिप्रिय.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 An exile, one who is driven from his house.
2 Family decay.
3 Breaking down or into a house.
E.
गृह, and भङ्ग breaking.

n. (-नं)
1 Breaking down or destroying a house.
2 Causing the ruin or decay of a family.
E.
गृह, and भञ्जन breaking.

f. (-मिः)
The site of a habitation.
E.
गृह a house, and भूमि ground.

m. (-णिः)
A lamp.
E.
गृह a house, and मणि a jewel.

f. (-का)
A bat.
E.
गृह a house, and माचिका a fly.

m. (-गः)
A dog.
E.
गृह a house, and मृग a deer.

m. (-धी)
A householder.
f. (-धिनी)
1 A housewife, the wife of a householder.
2 Natural sense or intelligence.
E.
गृह a house, मेध to understand, and इनि aff.

m. (-प्यः)
The householder, the master of a house or family.
E.
गृह to take, आप्य Uṇādi affix, and अय inserted.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Disposed to seize or take.
E.
गृह to take, अय inserted, and आलुच् aff.

n. (-न्ध्रं)
1 Private or family affairs, especially of an unpleasing nature.
2 A breach in the wall of a house.
E.
गृह, and रन्ध्र a hole; also गृहछिद्रं.

f. (-का)
A garden or grove near a house.
E.
गृह a house, वट to surround, affix ण्वुल्, and fem. form.

m. (-रः)
Household affairs, domestic economy.
E.
गृह, and व्यापार practice.

m. (-म्भः)
The pillar of a house.
E.
गृह, and स्तम्भ a post.

m. (-स्थः)
A householder, the man of the second class, or he who, after having finished his studies, and been invested with the sacred thread, performs the duties of the master of a house, and father of a family.
E.
गृह a house, and स्थ who stays or abides.

m. (-र्म्मः)
The practice or duty of a householder.
E.
गृहस्थ, and धर्म्म duty.

m. (-मः)
The order of householder.
E.
गृहस्थ, and आश्रम order of life.

n. (-णं)
The pillar of a house.
E.
गृह a house, and स्थूण a prop or pillar.

m. (-क्षः)
A loophole, an eyelet hole, a round or oblong window.
E.
गृह a house, and अक्ष for अक्षि an eye.

m. (-तः)
A guest.
E.
गृह, and आगत come to.

m. (-पः)
The Gṛhastha or householder: see गृहस्थ.
E.
गृह a house, and अधिप a master.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Watching, taking care of the house.
m. (-ली)
A watchman.
E.
गृह and अभि before पाल to protect, णिनि aff.

n. (-म्लं)
Sour gruel, made from the fermentation of rice water.
E.
गृह a house, and अम्ल sour, the domestic acid.

m. (-कः)
A householder.
E.
गृह a house, फिञ् derivative affix, and कन् added.

m. (-मः)
A garden, a grove, &c. near a house.
E.
गृह a house, and आराम a garden.

f. (-का)
A small lizard.
E.
गृह a house, आलि a scorpion, कन् affix of similitude.

f. (-णी)
The threshold, a raised ground or a terrace in front of the door.
E.
गृह a house, and अव prefixed to ग्रह to take, affixes ल्युट् and ङीप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dwelling or living in a house.
2 Lying in any place.
E.
गृह, and अवस्थित placed or situated in.

f. (-या)
The betel tree, (Piper betel.)
E.
गृह a house, &c. आशय an asylum, growing near dwellings.

m. (-श्मा)
A flat oblong stone, upon which condiments are ground together.
E.
गृह a house, and अश्मन् a stone.

f. (-णी)
A wife.
E.
गृह a house, and इनि and ङीष् affs.

m. (-ही)
A householder.
E.
गृह a house, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Taken, attached, seized, caught.
2

Obtained.
3

Known, understood.
4 Promised, agreed.
5 Learnt, acquired.
E.
ग्रह to take, affix क्त, र charged to ऋ.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Versed in science, learned, studied.
E.
गृहीत, and विद्या learning.

mfn. (-दिक्)
Flown, escaped, retreated.
E.
गृहीत seized, and दिश place.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Paid, remunerated.
E.
गृहीत, and वेतन wages.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Taking, disposed to seize or take.
E.
ग्रह to seize, affix तृच्, and ई inserted.

ind.
Having taken.
E.
ग्रह to take, क्त्वा aff.

n. (-णं)
Any domestic utensil.
E.
गृह, and उपकरण instrument.

m. (-तः)
1 A domestic nuisance, as vermin, &c.
2 Family misfortune.
E.
गृह, and उत्पात calamity.

f. (-का)
A small house lizard.
E.
गृह to take, and उल and कन् affixes: see गृहगोधिका.

mfn. (-ह्णन्-ह्णन्ती-ह्णत्)
Taking, seizing, accepting, &c.
E.
ग्रह to take, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
1 Dependant, subservient.
2 A partisan of or belonging to a side or party.
3 To be taken or seized.
4 To be trusted to, to be relied on.
5 To be acknowledged or admitted, to be adopted as faith or belief.
6 Domestic, of or belonging to a house.
m. (-ह्यः)
A tame or domesticated animal.
n. (-ह्यं)
1 The name of a book, containing directions for religious rites, a section or component treatise of the Sāma Veda, by GOBHILA and others; which contains rules for the performance of domestic and other ceremonies: the ritual of the Vedas.
f. (-ह्या)
A suburb, a village adjoining to a city, or a small village attached to a larger.
E.
ग्रह or गृह to take, affix क्यप्; or गृह a house, यत् affix; also with कन् added गृह्यक.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Dependent, docile, not following one's own inclinations.
m. (-कः)
A tame or domesticated animal, whether a bird or beast, &c.
E.
गृह for ग्रह to take, क्यप् affix, and कन् added.

m. (-रुः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
गृह्य, and गुरु a teacher.

n. (-त्रं)
A precept of the Gṛhya or ritual of the Vedas.
E.
गृह्य, and सूत्र a rule.
